split: original test.csv, all 1758 pairs, no semantic filtering or second agent
input: Raw premise and hypothesis texts only, separately interpreted by the same compiled seed. Original labels/review flags remain exclusively in the host scorer.
probe: Two unique identical complete semantic trees can support an equivalence-only entailment prediction. Otherwise abstain. An unrecognized text or abstention is never Neutral, NONE or a correct answer.
report: original generated labels and separately reviewer-agreed/clean strata
guardrail: This is a diagnostic for the current semantic interpreter, not a supplied NLI classifier or a sufficient M1 completion contract. No assertion that identical strings with no learned interpretation imply comprehension. Failed external coverage keeps the independent-language requirement open. Consumption of this test split is recorded and subsequent tuning cannot relabel it a fresh reserve.
scope: Public third-party Portuguese sentence-pair data. Corpus text/authorship is external to local AXON templates; file schema/math/memory operational acceptance remains separately required. MIT repository license retained; preserve dataset citation and quality annotations.
